description: This file defines an abstract class 'Entity' for Drupal's migrate module, providing a generic destination plugin to import entities, including methods for entity creation, loading, updating, and dependency calculation.

classes.name: Entity
classes.description: An abstract class providing a generic destination plugin for importing entities in Drupal's migrate module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the entity plugin with storage, bundles, and other configurations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the bundle for the current row, considering default configuration.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields; default is empty.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Creates or loads an entity based on the row data and old destination IDs.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses for updating an entity with row data.

methods.name: processStubRow
methods.description: Populates stub rows with default data; can be overridden.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID from the row.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Deletes the entity corresponding to the destination identifier.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates plugin dependencies, such as module dependencies.
